description:
The Bodo DataFrame adapter currently uses Pandas-compatible I/O only.
@bodo.jit is Bodo's core value proposition - auto-parallelization of Pandas
code via JIT compilation. MPI multi-node execution is the next tier.

Deferred from bodo-dataframe-platform (completed 2026-02-09). The initial
adapter established the Pandas-compatible baseline; these items add the
performance-differentiating features.

Note: the Bodo adapter source file does not currently exist in the codebase
(only __pycache__ artifacts remain). The adapter may need to be recreated
or the DONE item may have been completed as research-only.

work_units.summary: Verify Bodo adapter exists or recreate from DONE item - establish Pandas-compatible baseline

work_units.notes:
Start with simple TPC-H queries (Q1, Q6). JIT compilation adds warmup
overhead on first run; subsequent runs use cached compilation.
work_units.summary: Add @bodo.jit compilation mode - decorate query functions, handle warmup, implement compilation caching
